metadata.name: NeedType
metadata.description: Declares a type of dependency a module can ask whoever runs it for — a database, a credential, a public address — as the fields a fulfilment hands over, which are required, the parameters a request may state, and whether fulfilments are versioned, carry features or must come from the root.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: What a fulfilment hands over, as a JSON Schema property map. A field may be `x-telo-sensitive: true`, which a string field must be to hold a credential.

required.title: Required fields
required.description: The fields every fulfilment must yield.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: JSON Schema of the literal parameters a need of this type may state.

version.title: Version
version.description: `semver` when fulfilments are versioned: a need may then state a version range, which a consumer observing `version` verifies.

features.title: Features
features.description: The closed list of feature names a fulfilment may carry; a need may ask for a subset, which a consumer observing `features` verifies.

supply.title: Supply
supply.description: `root` when a need of this type is fulfilled only through a root need, forwarded whole: a self-supplied fulfilment, a field-by-field supply at an import and a library need reaching the root unforwarded are refused.
